workload: Same valid149block fixture and complete exact output; existing valid-only permissive Wasm baseline vs strict preflight plus same Wasm. Do not use permissive baseline on hostile inputs.
sampling: 11 pairs, alternating baseline/candidate order; fresh worker each job in warm browser, identical delayed HTTP server; raw measurements all retained.
metric: candidate minus baseline full worker job latency, including fetch and gate, runtime setup/remux/close; median increment <=250ms.
controls: Every output host decode full pixels and PCM exact. Runtime/cache/browser startup common and excluded; extra source transfer explicitly counted. No efficiency or CPU/memory claim.
